HOW FAR WILL YOU GO?

Trek Central shows you how far you can go in each assist mode and will adjust accordingly as you adjust assist modes. Trek Central calculates range using advanced algorithms that factor in not only rider weight and battery capacity, but also topographic terrain data as well as historical rider behavior.
